text:
anya (Product): PolarisRetail reached out — wants private pilot next week. Requirements: per-tenant KV cache, customer BYOK, HSM optional, and a 95ms P95 SLA for short prompts. They also asked for token-cost reporting. Can we scope an MVP?

sam (Eng-Runtime): 95ms P95 is aggressive. Short prompts help but HSM per-call will add latency; BYOK (envelope flow) avoids HSM calls at runtime. We need a smaller model/quant (eg opt-6.7b-8bit) and aggressive prewarm. Per-tenant cache multiplies memory by tenant count.

mike (Infra): To hit 95ms reliably we need reserved GPUs pinned to the pilot region, fast NVLink configs, and prewarmed instances. Normal lead time = 10bd; prioritized provisioning = 4-6bd. Also need network paths for customer KMS and IP allowlist.

lina (Security): Full HSM integration + attestation = ~3w (procure certs + review). We can run BYOK under a formal exception for a pilot if we capture envelope keys, access logs, and retention policy. Legal needs to sign pilot terms — I can draft the exception template in 48h.

carol (Eng-SRE): Observability: per-tenant latency dashboards, token-cost per-request, and an alert at 110ms. Recommend canary limited to PolarisRetail traffic and synthetic QPS spikes. We'll add an automated fallback route to hosted model when latency or errors spike. Also need an automated smoke harness.

anya (Product): Propose two paths: 
- Path Fast: BYOK + per-tenant cache + prewarm + target 95ms. Pilot in ~7bd.
- Path Compliant: HSM + attestation + audit + slower timeline (~4w).
Which do we pick for the Polaris pilot?

sam (Eng-Runtime): I'd take Path Fast to validate latency and behavior. I can add a runtime toggle for BYOK + cache + fallback in ~72h. Example config we can use:
```yaml
route: /v1/polaris/gen
model: redwood/opt-6.7b-q8
kms_mode: customer_byok
cache_strategy: per_tenant
fallback: hosted-optimized
prewarm: true
```

mike (Infra): If PM approves Fast, infra can reserve capacity in 4-6bd. If exec escalates we can do 3bd. Path Compliant pushes procurement and HSM cert timelines to ~3-4w.

lina (Security): For Fast path I'll prepare an exception checklist (envelope keys, access logs, rotation windows). Draft ready in 48h, legal review next.

carol (Eng-SRE): I'll prepare the canary runbook, dashboards, and smoke harness. Alert at 110ms and automated fallback configured. ETA: Thursday.

anya (Product): Decision: go with Path Fast for pilot (BYOK + per-tenant cache + 95ms P95 goal). Owners: sam runtime; mike infra; lina security; carol SRE. Please ack and add ETAs.

sam (Eng-Runtime): Ack. 72h for runtime flag + unit tests + basic perf run.

mike (Infra): Ack. 4bd for reserved infra; 3bd with exec sign-off.

lina (Security): Ack. Exception draft in 48h, then legal review.

carol (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook + dashboards by Thursday; will include rollback playbook and synthetic spike tests.

ops-bot: Created ticket POLARIS-PRIVATE-PILOT: https://tickets/POLARIS-PRIVATE-PILOT 00 — owners assigned, please update timelines in ticket.

anya (Product): I'll confirm scope with PolarisRetail and lock the pilot window. Weekly syncs M/W until completion. If we hit blockers we'll escalate. Thanks team :thumbsup:
